target: machine enforcement of continuity adversarial phase records

phases.claim_or_design_tested: The documentary protocol alone is sufficient to prevent incomplete adversarial records from acquiring authority.
challenge_method: searched the active protocol for executable enforcement
constructed counterexamples with missing rollback, partial coverage, and unsafe experiment scope
compared the protocol requirements with the current M-RECONCILE-002 evidence boundary
findings: The protocol defines required fields but does not mechanically reject malformed records.
A record could claim verified while reporting partial coverage unless a consumer independently notices the contradiction.
Safe-experiment boundaries were prose-only and therefore vulnerable to omission.
repairs: required checkpoint, target, attacks, findings, repairs, uncertainty, rollback, evidence quality, strength verdict, and next falsifiable step
added stricter requirements for verified status and intentional failure experiments
remaining_uncertainty: No repository-wide workflow currently invokes this validator automatically.
The full branch and commit traversal required to resolve M-004, M-005, and M-006 remains incomplete.
phases.evidence_quality: direct inspection of canonical queue and active protocol; implementation retained at immutable commits
phases.strength_reason: record completeness and claim-boundary contradictions now have a deterministic rejection path
phases.next_falsifiable_step: execute the Node test file in an authenticated checkout and retain exact output

phases.claim_or_design_tested: The validator rejects the highest-risk malformed records without touching protected systems.
challenge_method: created reversible negative controls for missing rollback
created verified status outside the verification checkpoint
created an unsafe intentional failure scope
created a safe reversible failure fixture
findings: The validator has explicit rejection codes for each negative control.
The implementation mutates no automation, schedule, canonical shared state, production system, deployment, or user data.
Static review found no success path that converts partial coverage into verified status.
repairs: added duplicate guards for both generic verified coverage and explicit partial coverage
required verified records to include evidence, negative controls, and a bounded claim statement
restricted intentional failure experiments to reversible fixtures
remaining_uncertainty: Tests are committed but were not executed through the connector.
